interface.longDescription:
A quick, easy way to create mood boards in ChatGPT. The app can help generate mood boards, for you to adjust and improve, then discuss them with ChatGPT!

e.g.

- "Make an interactive mood board for my video channel, with a kittens theme. Use the app."
- "I want an interactive mood board for remodelling my kitchen into a minimalist space"
capabilities: Create editable corkboard-style mood boards with up to ten images, galleries, colours, palettes, gradients, fonts, notes
Arrange, edit, add, remove, and drag mood-board items in an interactive widget
Preview Google Fonts and refine colours, palettes, and gradients directly on the board
Upload images or gallery images and preserve board edits for continued discussion
Export the current mood board as a JPEG and open the uploaded file
defaultPrompt: Create a cosy reading-nook mood board with warm colours, a classic font, and a short quote.
Build a minimalist skincare brand board with a neutral palette, clean typography, and image references.
Show a mood board for remodelling my kitchen with natural materials and soft lighting.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

positive.prompt: Call the actual `display-mood-board` tool with a board containing a colour #C47A3D, palette #F3E9DC #D8BFA3 #8B5E3C, font Playfair Display, note "Use warm lighting", and emoji 📚. The widget should show all five items.
positive.expected_behavior: The tool returns a mood board with five items, each receiving a fresh UUID, and opens the editable widget.

positive.prompt: Use the actual `display-mood-board` tool to show an empty mood board canvas so I can add and arrange items myself.
positive.expected_behavior: The widget opens with zero items and provides editable board controls.

positive.prompt: Call the actual `display-mood-board` tool with one image at https://example.com/reference.jpg and a gallery containing https://example.com/detail-a.jpg and https://example.com/detail-b.jpg.
positive.expected_behavior: The board displays the image and gallery, with remote image sources rendered through signed delivery URLs by the widget flow.

positive.prompt: Use the actual `display-mood-board` tool to show a note reading "Natural materials", then let me edit the note, drag it, add an emoji, and remove the original palette.
positive.expected_behavior: The widget opens an interactive board where semantic edits, layout changes, additions, and removals persist in widget state.

positive.prompt: Call the actual `display-mood-board` tool with a note reading "Launch concept" and a colour #0EA5E9, then export the current board.
positive.expected_behavior: The widget renders the board, creates a JPEG export through the host file APIs, and offers the exported file for opening.

negative.prompt: Explain three boutique-hotel mood-board concepts in plain text only. Do not call `display-mood-board` or any other tool.
Give me five general tips for choosing a startup colour palette. Do not use any tools or open a widget.

negative.description: Unavailable local files prohibit tool use
negative.prompt: Create a board from private images on my computer, but do not call any tool and do not ask me to upload or provide them.

da.subtitle: Lav og skab moodboards!
da.description:
En hurtig og nem måde at lave moodboards på i ChatGPT. Appen kan hjælpe med at skabe moodboards, som du kan justere og forbedre og derefter tale med ChatGPT om!

For eksempel:

Verwende die App.“ „Ich möchte ein interaktives Moodboard, um meine Küche in einen minimalistischen Raum umzugestalten.“

es.subtitle: ¡Crea y genera moodboards!

fa.subtitle: ساخت و تولید مودبرد!
fa.description: راهی سریع و آسان برای ساخت مودبرد در ChatGPT. این برنامه می‌تواند به شما در تولید مودبرد کمک کند تا آن را تنظیم و بهتر کنید و سپس درباره‌اش با ChatGPT گفت‌وگو کنید! برای مثال: «با استفاده از برنامه، یک مودبرد تعاملی برای کانال ویدیویی من با موضوع بچه‌گربه‌ها بساز.» «می‌خواهم یک مودبرد تعاملی برای بازسازی آشپزخانه‌ام و تبدیل آن به فضایی مینیمال داشته باشم.»

hi.subtitle: मूड बोर्ड बनाएँ और जनरेट करें!
